system.description: The Stormkelt asks Windinna for the ability to see into the mind and heart of a person. This ability is often used in interrogations and legal matters. The dimwalker directs the ability toward a person within range and can use it to judge if the person is lying or telling the truth. The ability lasts for one minute.
